The '''k-blakan mini sensor''' was a [[Rear Warning Sensor]] manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]]. [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] used the k-blakan mini sensor as part of the [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] package built into their [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. Positioned in the rear of the [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]], the sensor provided the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] with information from behind the craft, including incoming vessels and sensor sweeps.<ref name="SWS" />
